standard-dialogue.npc: Nilsal, traveller. You walk on holy ground. Please ensure you are respectful.

entering-the-crypt-of-tonali.text: If the player attempts to enter the Crypt of Tonali without finishing The Final Dawn:

steps.npc: I'm sorry, traveller, but access into the Crypt of Tonali is restricted. You may not enter.

after-defending-the-crypt-of-tonali-duri.npc: Nilsal, adventurer. Good work in dealing with those cultist!

after-completing-the-final-dawn.npc: Nilsal, adventurer. I hope you are doing well?
